supporting_observations.claim: DC-HD-01 recorded two failed network logons for HARBOR-DENTAL\ben.carter at 13:41:55 and 13:43:20 UTC. Both used NTLM, originated from ::ffff:192.0.2.45, and reported SubStatus 0xc000006a, indicating an incorrect password.
At 13:44:45 UTC, DC-HD-01 recorded a successful Kerberos network logon for ben.carter from the same source IP, ::ffff:192.0.2.45.

The failures followed by success warrant source and user validation, but do not distinguish legitimate password retries from unauthorized authentication. The successful logon used a different authentication package from the failures.

Explorer wrote Chrome-related and Excel-related UserAssist entries under ben.carter on WS-BCARTER-01 before and after the authentication events. These records provide workstation context but do not attribute the source IP or establish that the domain logons were authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: Collection-status metadata reports a proxy-log outage from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, covering the authentication sequence; this limits web-activity corroboration, not the recorded authentication facts.

Although the listed Windows and network sensors are reported healthy, the supplied evidence contains only six records and provides no source-IP-to-host mapping or source-process telemetry for the logons in T011-00003 through T011-00005.
claims_not_established: Which device or user controlled 192.0.2.45 during T011-00003 through T011-00005, including whether it was WS-BCARTER-01.
Whether the failed logons were user mistakes, stale credentials, or deliberate password guessing.
Whether the successful logon in T011-00005 was authorized or resulted in subsequent resource access.
Neither malicious activity nor a benign explanation is established by the failure-to-success sequence alone.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain historical DHCP, IPAM, or endpoint network records mapping 192.0.2.45 at 13:41–13:45 UTC.
Confirm with ben.carter whether he initiated these logons and experienced password-entry failures.

Retrieve source-endpoint process and authentication records, plus domain-controller authentication details, for 13:20–14:20 UTC to identify the initiating application and correlate the NTLM failures with the Kerberos success.
Correlate TargetLogonId 0x94fa7fa from T011-00005 with subsequent resource-access and session activity.
unrelated_findings: T011-00002 records explorer.exe setting ben.carter's ProxyEnable value to 0 on WS-BCARTER-01 at 13:39:30 UTC. Review separately whether disabling the explicit proxy was authorized; this record does not establish a causal connection to the alerted logons.
